name: Prospective v3 single-primary frozen model manifest
feature_definition: For each mutant, compute full-sequence ESM-2 embeddings for WT and mutant; retain all per-residue differences; sum the difference vectors at explicit substituted sequence indices to obtain the intervention vector.
leakage_controls: feature preparation receives no mutant-population targets
PCA is fit anew in each outer fold using only outer-training mutant residue rows
PCA fit IDs and parameter hash are emitted per fold
nested selection uses only inner folds within the corresponding outer-training set
primary comparator uses identical outer folds
immutability: Any change before first data contact requires a new numbered version and amendment record. Any change after data contact is a deviation and cannot replace v3 results.
